question: Should this Feishu media fallback PR require live Feishu Open Platform proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the mocked client-seam proof?
rationale: The source fix is narrow and aligns with the existing fallback contract, but the repository proof gate treats external channel-delivery fixes as needing real behavior proof unless maintainers intentionally waive that gap.

options.title: Require live Feishu proof
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until the contributor posts redacted live Feishu output, logs, terminal output, or a short recording showing image/file fallback delivery and unsafe native-thread refusal.

options.title: Accept mocked seam proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the source-level and mocked-seam proof because the PR reuses the already-shipped text/card fallback helper while owning the remaining live transport uncertainty.

options.title: Choose another canonical branch
options.body: If another Feishu fallback PR becomes the chosen landing path, close this PR only after confirming the replacement has equivalent helper reuse, dispatcher forwarding, tests, and proof.

recommendation.title: Require live Feishu proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR blocked until the contributor posts redacted live Feishu output, logs, terminal output, or a short recording showing image/file fallback delivery and unsafe native-thread refusal.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior merged Feishu fallback work is the closest ownership signal for the reply fallback contract this PR extends.
